scientific.integrity: The infinite deficiency count is proved analytically by the weighted-discrete correspondence, a one-dimensional transfer recurrence, and a summability argument. The bundled finite checker is corroborative only.
scientific.limitations: The theorem treats the one-ended comb with exactly two terminal teeth per spine vertex and arbitrary positive edge lengths of finite total sum. It does not extend the conclusion to arbitrary one-ended finite-volume graphs or other vertex couplings.

title: Deficiency one for finite-volume asymmetric quantum combs
